England squad: Palmer and Trent back as snubbed star's partner takes aim at Thomas Tuchel
Thomas Tuchel has announced his latest England squad as the Three Lions all prepare for an extended, revamped three-week international break across late September and early October

Comments20
Sport
Isaac Seelochan Senior Sports Journalist, John Cross Chief Football Writer and Kieran King Senior Sports Writer
Updated 17:25, 18 Sep 2026

Thomas Tuchel has named his 26-man England squad for the upcoming international break. Chelsea's Cole Palmer and Real Madrid's Trent Alexander-Arnold have received recalls.
Palmer has impressed under Xabi Alonso this season, scoring four times and adding two assists in five appearances. He is back in the Three Lions camp after missing the World Cup. Another face returning to the England fold is Al

Elsewhere, Bournemouth's Alex Scott and Liverpool's Rio Ngumoha have been selected by Tuchel, who were included in the four-person warm-up group before the World Cup earlier this summer. Lewis Hall also makes it following an excellent start to the season at Newcastle United, while Everton's Jarrad Branthwaite has earned a place as a reward for a solid start to the campaign.
